title: Minecraft Randomness
description: Adds some items like the chainsaw, dagger, multi-use totem, and insta-kill that have been suggested for years. Some items like the chimkin leg though were never asked for but are still useful. This mod also adds new mobs like the platypus and perry.
body: Adds new weapons like the chainsaw and dagger or new mining tools like the chimkin leg the mines three by three. This mod also adds new mobs like the shadow (ambient) or platypus (tamable). Also adds a new potion called the stun effect.
